about.heroTitle: Bringing merchants, talent and customers together in Guinea.
about.heroDescription: is the all-in-one platform that digitizes local commerce, showcases service providers, and speeds up hiring through the power of WhatsApp.
about.storyText: We believe in commerce that is accessible, fast and human. In Guinea, thousands of entrepreneurs, artisans and independent workers drive the economy. Makitii gives them the digital tools to shine and reach a wider customer base.
about.whySubtitle: A concrete answer to the needs of the Guinean market
about.whyText1: Buying or selling online shouldn't be complicated. With Makitii, every vendor has a professional online catalog and every customer can talk to them directly, with no barriers.
about.whyText2: Whether you're looking for a fashion item, a good restaurant, a freelancer to build your website, or a technician to repair your equipment, it's all in one place.

pillar1.title: Local Businesses & Shops
pillar1.description: We give merchants, artisans and restaurateurs a powerful digital storefront to grow their visibility and sales.

pillar2.title: Freelancers & Professional Services
pillar2.description: Developers, designers, repair technicians and independent contractors find direct clients here to showcase their skills.

pillar3.title: Direct Recruitment & Jobs
pillar3.description: Making it easier to access job opportunities by connecting recruiters and candidates directly via WhatsApp with no administrative barriers.

pillar4.title: Instant WhatsApp Contact
pillar4.description: Order, ask questions or negotiate directly with vendors on WhatsApp, with no middleman and no hidden fees.

contact.faqSubtitle: Find instant answers to common questions.

faq1.q: How can I open a store or offer my services on Makitii?
faq1.a: Click on 'Become a vendor' in the navigation bar, fill out the registration form with your details and your WhatsApp number. Your store will be reviewed and activated quickly.

faq2.q: Are there any fees or commissions on sales?
faq2.a: No, Makitii connects buyers and sellers directly on WhatsApp. You manage your transactions and payments directly with your customers, with full freedom.

faq3.q: How do I apply for a job offer?
faq3.a: Go to the 'Jobs' section, select the offer you're interested in, and click 'Apply on WhatsApp' to contact the employer immediately with a pre-filled message.

faq4.q: Where is the Makitii team based?
faq4.a: Our team is based in Conakry, Guinea, and we support merchants and freelancers across the whole country.
